settings.aiHint: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works; defaults to DeepSeek. Reading a timetable screenshot needs a vision model (DeepSeek's V4-Flash-Vision series) — plain text models like deepseek-chat cannot read images. The key stays on this machine.
settings.modelsFound: Found {{n}} models — click to fill. ◉ = the name mentions vision
settings.noVisionHint: No vision-named model is fine — deepseek-flash was measured to read timetable screenshots directly, so just pick it.
settings.localOnly: Everything is stored on this machine. Only timetable screenshots are sent to the provider configured above.
